# ParsiKit — Machine-Readable LLM Summary
# Source: https://parsikit.dev
# Repository: https://github.com/MRThugh/ParsiKit
# Author: Ali Kamrani (MRThugh)
# License: MIT
# Version: 3.3.1
# Python Requirement: >=3.10

## Project Description
ParsiKit (`parsikit`) is a production-grade, zero-dependency, pure Python library providing Persian and domestic data infrastructure. It includes text cleansing and Zero-Width Non-Joiner (ZWNJ) normalization, national identification checksums (Modulo 11), bank card verification (Luhn algorithm), bank issuer BIN detection, Sheba IBAN verification (ISO 7064 Mod 97-10), astronomical Solar Hijri (Jalali) calendar conversions with 33-year leap cycle support, number-to-words spelling in Persian, currency conversions (Rial/Toman), VAT calculation, PII masking, and thread-safe in-memory caching.

## Official Multilingual Documentation
- English: https://parsikit.dev/en/docs/installation
- Persian (Iran): https://parsikit.dev/fa/docs/installation
- Dari (Afghanistan): https://parsikit.dev/prs-af/docs/installation
- Tajik (Tajikistan): https://parsikit.dev/tg/docs/installation

## Key Modules and API Summary

### 1. `parsikit.text`
- `clean_text(text: str) -> str`: Normalizes Arabic Yeh/Kaf to Persian, standardizes spaces and ZWNJ (\u200c).
- `to_persian_digits(text: str) -> str`: Converts Latin (0-9) and Arabic digits to Persian digits (۰-۹).
- `to_latin_digits(text: str) -> str`: Converts Persian/Arabic digits to ASCII Latin (0-9).
- `remove_diacritics(text: str) -> str`: Strips Arabic/Persian vowels and accents (Tashdid, Tanwin, Fathah, etc.).
- `slugify(text: str) -> str`: Transliterates Persian text to SEO-friendly ASCII Pinglish slug.

### 2. `parsikit.validators`
- `is_valid_national_code(code: str) -> bool`: Verifies 10-digit National ID using Modulo 11 checksum.
- `is_valid_card(card_number: str) -> bool`: Validates 16-digit debit/credit card numbers using the Luhn algorithm.
- `is_valid_sheba(sheba_number: str) -> bool`: Validates IBAN numbers (format IR + 24 digits, ISO 7064 Mod 97-10).
- `is_valid_postal_code(postal_code: str) -> bool`: Verifies 10-digit postal codes.
- `is_valid_mobile(phone_number: str) -> bool`: Validates mobile numbers against authorized operator prefixes.

### 3. `parsikit.datetime`
- `JalaliDate(year, month, day)`: Pythonic Jalali date object with formatting and arithmetic.
- `gregorian_to_jalali(gy, gm, gd) -> (jy, jm, jd)`: Converts Gregorian date to Solar Hijri date.
- `jalali_to_gregorian(jy, jm, jd) -> (gy, gm, gd)`: Converts Solar Hijri date to Gregorian date.
- `is_jalali_leap(jy: int) -> bool`: Calculates astronomical Solar Hijri leap years (33-year cycle).

### 4. `parsikit.number_and_currency`
- `number_to_words(number: int | float) -> str`: Converts digits to Persian words (e.g. 1,000 -> یک هزار).
- `rial_to_toman(amount: int | float) -> int | float`: Divides Rial amount by 10.
- `toman_to_rial(amount: int | float) -> int | float`: Multiplies Toman amount by 10.
- `calculate_vat(amount: int | float, rate: float = 0.10) -> (vat_amount, total_with_vat)`: VAT calculation.

### 5. `parsikit.security`
- `mask_card(card: str) -> str`: Masks middle digits of a bank card (e.g., 6037-99**-****-1234).
- `mask_mobile(phone: str) -> str`: Masks middle digits of mobile phone numbers (e.g., 0912***1234).
- `mask_national_code(code: str) -> str`: Masks initial digits of national identity codes.

### 6. `parsikit.cache` & `parsikit.config`
- `thread_safe_lru_cache`: Internal high-throughput caching for repetitive mathematical conversions.
- Configurable settings for default currency, VAT rate, and cache size limits.

## Installation
```bash
pip install parsikit
```
